transcript: Speaker A (Rajesh): Went abroad for the first time. At immigration, the officer asked five questions in English. I couldn't answer even one. They kept me in a separate room for two hours while my family waited outside. My name is Rajesh. I planned a trip to Thailand with my family. At Bangkok immigration, the officer asked: 'What is the purpose of your visit?' I understood but couldn't speak. I struggled with broken words. They took me to a back room. My daughter was crying outside. Another officer asked for my return ticket and hotel booking verbally. I froze. After two hours they let us go, but the fear in my daughter's eyes haunted me. The whole trip was a struggle to order food or talk to taxi drivers. Back home, my roommate showed me the English Seekho app. He said: 'It has a 1 rupee trial, try it.' I doubted myself at age 42, but he motivated me. I downloaded it, watched short expert videos in Hindi, and practiced travel English with the AI coach. Three months later, we went to Dubai. When the officer asked our purpose, I answered fluently in English. My daughter was thrilled. Download the English Seekho app, practice with the AI coach for just 1 rupee. summary: A father shares his embarrassing experience of being detained at airport immigration in Thailand because he couldn't speak English, which ruined his family trip. He uses the English Seekho app's 1-rupee trial and AI coach to learn travel English, leading to a successful and confident family trip to Dubai. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
